scope: Home selection through detail commands, conversation, background recovery, and return home
interactionPolicy: Detail mascot tap opens one request and pauses immediately. Answer completion restores prior playback and closes the request, without a twenty-second follow-up window. Explicit pause stays paused. Ad skip confirms before seeking, then restores its prior playing/paused intent. Silence and backgrounding cancel unfinished collection. Wake remains an optional existing path; physical foreground capture still waits for wake after a tap request closes.

software.iosJavaScriptExport: passed; not a native device run
software.renderedPreview: Updated listening, playing and home layouts inspected at a 390 by 844 browser viewport. Detail artwork and captions are above the larger lower mascot. Browser fixture has no real audio; native tap hit testing, animation and safe-area layout still need phone verification.
software.tapFlow: Unit coverage includes immediate pause, unprefixed question, exact auto-resume, explicit pause, silent timeout, already-paused question, episode switch, return home, background cancellation, home invitation and confirmation-before-seek for ad skipping from both playing and paused states. Four-guest live text flow passed with tap-to-resume, real generated reply bytes and media range requests; native player simulated.

software.liveQuietAudioFlow: Prior ducking version passed the full generated-PCM flow. The pause-on-wake version has not yet repeated this quiet-audio matrix.

Final end the stream was transcribed as Nd the stream or And the stream and routed to clarification. Neither is counted as full success.
software.catalogSpeechNames: Generic semantic spelling guidance passes Cat Woo, Boris Cherney, Claire Voe and rejects two unavailable shows. No guest-specific production aliases or threshold changes.

software.providerStability: One live catalog run rejected an invalid provider distribution. Five- and twenty-round repeats passed. Not attributed to the phone failure without matching telemetry.
software.requestRecovery: Red-to-green tests prove greeting, selection speech and detail request failures keep capture available, leave playback paused and accept a new wake. Fatal microphone failures still stop capture. UI distinguishes Ready to retry from a disconnected microphone.

software.allCatalogSelection: All 50 available catalog entries selected correctly by supplied title in a live Jev test; this is selection coverage, not playback or microphone coverage
software.nativeSpeechHandoff: Phone log confirms confirmation bytes loaded but native playback never started before timeout. Shared speech now waits for native source readiness before play; cancellation tests pass. This is a candidate repair requiring device verification, not a confirmed root-cause fix. System media controls now register after actual podcast playback instead of during loading.

openGates: User-reported home/detail voice failure is not device verified after these changes; diagnostics now distinguish speech request, native start, native completion and transcription failures without logging spoken words
Intermittent generated speech timeout and catalog response validation failure remain observed service failures; recovery is tested but service availability is not guaranteed
Mixed podcast and command audio failed to preserve the spoken command in transcription; matching isolated command audio transcribes correctly
Physical phone speaker wake recognition and audible confirmation/action ordering are unverified
Native background playback, Lock Screen controls, and reopen are unverified
Expo native remote-control pause has no command provenance in the current JS status API; simultaneous capture teardown and system pause remains a device race risk
verificationLimits: Pstack is an engineering workflow, not a bundled application test suite
Independent available-model design and code reviews were used; pstack's named model families and Cursor-only review tools were unavailable
Simulator tools were unavailable on this Mac
The live flow places a simulated player inside the reviewed ad; it does not verify spoken compound timestamps

An earlier full-flow pass failed on repetition at resume after background controls; the equivalent current/resume destination fix was followed by two full text-flow passes
nativeCaptureFinding: Installed Expo iOS AudioStream starts in measurement mode and does not enable AVAudioEngine voice processing. No echo-cancellation option is exposed in its stream options. This is a candidate cause of speaker interference, not a proven diagnosis of the user's phone.
nextDecision: Native capture experiment is on hold while testing the user-approved pause-on-wake behavior in Expo Go. This JavaScript change does not require Xcode or a development build. Native microphone changes still would.
